content.rendered:

Guides on how to play the game effectively on your device can also be found online when you carry out a quick Google search to know more about DLS 18 for Android.

This guides includes tips on how to use the control buttons of the dream League such as using the B button to put pressure on the player, by doing that you have the chance of taking control over the ball.

The C button is to choose which of your team player have can control the ball to go and score your opponent.

” A” button makes you to shoot the ball in order to score your opponent easily..
